EC1: 1. history of prior laser treatment [OR] or vitrectomy in the study eye;
EC2: 2. history of thromboembolic event - including myocardial infarction [OR] or cerebral vascular accident;
EC3: 3. major surgery within the prior 6 months [OR] or planned within the next 28 days;
EC4: 4. history of glaucoma [OR] or ocular hypertension;
EC5: 5. loss of vision as a result of other causes;
EC6: 6. history of systemic corticosteroid therapy within the last 3 months;
EC7: 7. severe systemic disease other than diabetes mellitus;
EC8: 8. known coagulation abnormalities [OR] or current use of anticoagulative medication other than aspirin
EC9: 9. any condition that could affect followup [OR] or documentation (including preretinal [OR] or vitreous hemorrhage).
